_meta.description: Per-row hat-matrix leverage h_ii on customers.pulse (target income, predictors [age]) via ATTR_REG_LEVERAGE. Leverage measures each row's structural pull on the OLS fit independently of its residual; sum(h_ii) = p + 1 (the predictor count plus the intercept), so the mean here is 2/n. Rows with h_ii near 1 are the ones to inspect. A penalty is refused: the hat matrix is defined only for unpenalised OLS.
_meta.name: attr_reg_leverage
